tasks.prompt: Write a product description of 80 to 120 words for a reusable water bottle. It must mention the insulation and the leak-proof lid. Do not use the words 'revolutionary' or 'game-changer'.

Write a polite email of 60 to 120 words declining a meeting on Tuesday and proposing Thursday instead. Begin with the line 'Hi Sam,' and end with the sign-off name 'Alex'. Do not use the word 'unfortunately'.
List exactly three benefits of unit testing as three bullet points. Each bullet must start with '- ' and be 20 words or fewer. Output only the bullets.
Write exactly two paragraphs, 80 to 150 words in total, about why sleep matters. Mention both 'memory' and 'mood'. Separate the paragraphs with a blank line.
